reviews.title: Overall Helpful
reviews.text: I like the alarm and overall it has been helpful but there are a few things that haven’t been great. It does save my alarm settings and often shuts the alarm off all together. I have to double check each night that it is set even if I set the schedule. I also changes the alarm sound on its own to a very jarring and abrupt sound even when I set it on something else. Overall, it has been very helpful to get me up in the morning. But there are glitches and every time I’ve tried to each out about it I get radio silence. It’s a good option but I’m also curious about other better companies without the glitches.

reviews.title: randomly went off in public
reviews.text:
it’s a good app theoretically, but there’s a few technical bugs.
     first, whenever you click on an alarm to edit it, the time you set it to go off at changes to the current time. and if you don’t catch it, it will go off the next day at that same time. this happened to me once. luckily, i was at home so it wasn’t that big of a deal. but it can be an issue for those who don’t notice it or just forget to change it back.
     second, if you have another alarm (either another flow alarm or one you set on your phones built-in app) that goes off before you can turn off the initial alarm, one of them (normally the first one) will be canceled out and then go off at a random time of day, making it completely unpredictable. this happened to me right before an event once. i tried shutting off my phone and turning it back on because i didn’t want to use my emergency pass for an app glitch but when i turned it back on, it just continued. then it happened to me again at a friends house and i just deleted the app. however, when you sign in again, you have to start over from scratch essentially. you’d think that creating an account would allow you to restore everything but it doesn’t. you have to redo all of the intro questions and recreate every single alarm. then an alarm overlapped again and i just turned off all of my alarms, then forgot i turned them off, then didn’t have them for the next morning. then it happened to me again and i just deleted it. i ended up deleting and reinstalling it multiple times because the same thing kept happening. but this time there wasn’t an overlapping alarm. i turned it off as normal but the second alarm didn’t go off when it was supposed to, it just went off during school. so another student heard it and tried turning it off but it wouldn’t turn off, so they gave it to the principal and she emailed all of my grade asking whose phone it was. so i almost got my phone taken away which was exceptionally annoying. now, with the new phone ban, if your alarm goes off while your phone is locked, you’re essentially doomed bc what’re you gonna do?
     aside from those issues, i think it would be beneficial to add a 'hybrid' alarm challenge. for example, requiring the user to scan the dock and then immediately solve math problems. and then for premium users, they could mix and match the premium challenges to turn off their alarm. i used to have two alarms one minute apart. one that has me scan the dock and the other that has me doing math problems, but if i didn’t get to the dock on time, id have to turn them both off so neither of them went off randomly. then i kept forgetting to turn them back on so i tried moving them to 5 minutes apart but then in those 5 minutes, id be back in bed and then do the math problems. but when i timed it just right and the math alarm went off while i was still standing, i stayed up. 

anyway, those are just my thoughts and opinions. thanks for reading (:

reviews.title: Good when it works
reviews.text: It works great when it works. As others have stated, I cannot get the snooze feature to work. I also periodically will have it not go off in the morning, just to have it sound randomly during the day leaving me unable to turn it off because I’m driving down the highway, not within scanning distance of my fridge where I keep the magnet.

reviews.title: Terrible Tech Support
reviews.text: The product seemed to work before it glitched and I could set an alarm. Tech support has been slow and unhelpful. If you buy one you better pray you NEVER need to contact the company for ANYTHING !!!

reviews.title: Great App, with a few glitches
reviews.text: This app has worked wonders in getting me up and moving in the morning. I have definitely noticed an improvement in arriving to work on time. There are a few glitches however. I selected the one time 5-min snooze button so that I can get a few min to naturally wake my body up instead of getting shocked into bolting for the cube immediately after it rings. However, as soon as I hit snooze the alarm comes back almost instantly, which gives me a headache. Also, the alarm itself keeps auto updating to the current time whenever I access the settings, which is a little annoying. Lastly, the alarm sound automatically starts at 100% volume and fights me when I try to turn it down, which is very frustrating when I’m trying to get up while not waking up everyone else in my house. Otherwise it’s a great idea for a product

reviews.title: Was good…but doesn’t work anymore
reviews.text: It worked for a little, but now the alarm will not sound when I schedule it even if it’s on. Useful for a little bit and enjoy trying it out, but no longer works. Sometimes I wouldn’t even schedule an alarm and it would just go off in the middle of my work day, which would be frustrating bc it would block my apps. Emergency turn off feature doesn’t work anymore, as well.

reviews.title: It sorta works... Not really.
reviews.text: Firstly, this is not free once you buy the brick. There is a subscription service that they don’t mention anything about on the website. The actual dock itself took two whole months to ship, where I had tried asking for a refund multiple times but was denied. Using it now, the app works sorta fine… it rings correctly at the right times BUT I have to go in every night and change the sound so I don’t get ear raped by their default alarm noise the next morning. This is honestly beyond frustrating. ALSO, when you do change the sounds, make sure you set that alarm time back to when you want to wake up, because it will revert your alarm time to whenever you try to edit it. This is a great idea for an app to wake you up but it was executed so horribly. Save your money.

I have had several mornings that the alarm was not going off but once I unlocked my phone then the sound could be heard. Please fix issue when going into the actual alarm to make changes to sound stop updating my alarm time. I don’t want to keep setting a back up alarm just in case this one doesn’t work. reviews.title: Terrible Customer Support
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Flow Alarm. Their customer service is practically nonexistent. Yet they had no problem charging my card immediately.

Right after placing my order, I realized I had entered the wrong shipping address. I contacted customer service immediately to have it corrected before the order was processed. I sent between three and five emails and never received a response.

A company that processes payments so quickly should be equally responsive when customers need help with an order. Something as simple as correcting a shipping address should not be ignored. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend Flow Alarm because of the lack of customer support.

So here I have something sent to my old home in whole different state. May give unbed a chances since their customer service has been responsive since they both been showing up on my IG & FB.

reviews.title: Bad taste in mouth
reviews.text:
It took a month to arrive, then once it finally showed up, I discovered the $60 hardware was basically just the entry fee.

If you want access to anything beyond the most stripped-down, bare-minimum version of the product, you have to pay for an annual subscription.

Sure, technically it “works” without the subscription. But that feels like a loophole, not a real feature. The free version is so limited it feels intentionally crippled to push you into paying more.

Terrible first impression. I didn’t feel like I bought a product, I felt like I bought my way into another paywall. Ugh.

reviews.title: Great concept but…
reviews.text:
I like my Flow alarm clock. I’ve definitely noticed an improvement in my sleep patterns (going to bed earlier, waking up and staying awake, and feeling more refreshed as a result). However, similar to other reviews, I am very disappointed with the omission of the subscription required to access all of flows features. I paid $40 for the Flow dock thinking I snagged a deal for this miracle solution to my sleeping in habits. Just to find out it costs an additional $40 to access all the features. Without the subscription, the alarm is literally the only feature accessible. Including a very limited selection of alarm sounds while the rest require the subscription. 
Also, the flow dock arrived about a month late and was promised updates weekly which did not happen. I had to email them to confirm my order was coming. I never received an email back but it came in the mail shortly after, so I am suspicious that I wouldn’t have received it if I didn’t reach out. 
Finally, there are some practical concerns. It won’t allow me to have more than 2 alarms. Second, I enjoy the sleep tracking feature, but theres been a couple days where I wake up and my sleep was not tracked when I know I initiated the feature prior to going to bed the night before. It says the feature won’t work if I close the app, but that should not apply to my phone locking on it’s own if thats the case. I understand it is a fairly new business, but it should not be this expensive, especially considering all of these pitfalls.

reviews.title: Good Idea, Questionable Execution
reviews.text:
Love flow as a product as a whole, overall good idea. However there are a couple of things that are holding this device back from being great. 
1. App interface. The mobile app feels like it is built on lovable.com, with many of its features being laggy and it consistently logs me out of my account each and everyday, and when i log back in I must go through the same 5 minute process of setting up the app again and connecting it to my doc. 
2. Alarm not always working. In the morning, the alarm typically does go off, however I have noticed that if I do not touch it for 5-10 minutes it shuts off on its own, which is interesting. On top of that turning down volume can also shut it off on occasion. 
3. App block not working. For the past two weeks I have had this, the app block only worked for when the alarm was going off, but as soon as I turned off the alarm, the app block would lift. 

In a whole, the core functionality of the product works, however these few things are holding me back from purchasing more products as gifts for family/friends. I want to buy the subscription, but have lost faith because of these problems. 

I would highly recommend for the team to focus on a good product with a functioning app with minimal bugs, before pushing a subscription.

reviews.title: Most useful app to change my priority habits
reviews.text: I hate leave reviews on apps, but this one has been especially helpful for me. Waking up on time had been an issue for me for a while now and with the task-alarms that’s no longer a thing. However, the most useful feature for me it’s the app blocking. The fact that it kicks you out of the apps u select after a certain amount of time, its game changing. None of the other apps had worked for me bc I would override the warning, but literally kicking me out of instagram has been the only way to actually bring my screen time down. I hope the developers get to see this review bc man I never leave them but damn it’s been so helpful. Thanks y’all

reviews.title: Paywall is BS
reviews.text: Not everything should have a pay wall.  You guys can clearly see everyone thinks that sucks.  Not to mention the fact I was not even made aware of said paywall until I emailed the company about not getting the box until well after a month after I ordered it, and paid for expedited shipping (like an idiot). They offered a year of access instead of refunding shipping. That’s cool, why I gave 2 stars instead of one.  Stop being greedy.  If your costs of manufacturing a box you charge $40 for is too much, even though it’s 99% likely you’re getting the boxes made in some sweatshop overseas, then charge more for the box, $60 without a stupid pay wall.  Do better.  If you want my feedback and data, as well as referrals, do better.  Great thing about capitalism is we can speak our mind with our wallet. These things will most certainly get lost, and need to be replaced. Charge a little more up front and drop the paywall. This ain’t Netflix.  Get over yourselves, stop being arrogant. You’ll make a ton of money still and you’ll get to 4.7 overall ratings instead of sitting at 4. Do better, Flow. Get in that flow.  Maybe cut salaries of executives as an idea to get rid of the paywall. You will fail, in time otherwise. Especially if you keep advertising no sub. F your paywall. F your greed. Do better and I’ll change this to a 5 star.
